verdict.rationale: Netlify is a web hosting and deployment platform, so a global CDN with edge caching is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a CDN, edge caching, cache headers or global asset distribution. The closest items cover deploys, automatic HTTPS/DDoS protection and a third-party Turso edge database, none of which is the requested capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching
